description: Aerial imagery displaying a winding blue river on the left side, flowing through a landscape characterised by bare rock outcrops and sparse vegetation. A prominent, dark, linear geological formation, likely a cliff or rugged rock ridge, runs roughly parallel to the river. The surrounding terrain features patches of reddish-coloured vegetation, indicative of photosynthetic activity (e.g., scrub or low bushes) in a false-colour infrared representation, interspersed with greenish-blue areas of bare ground or extremely sparse, non-vigorous vegetation. The image illustrates land cover features such as bare rocks, outcrops, cliffs, and eroded areas with minimal high vegetation.
